notes: text: おまケガはもういいのか? — is your injury really okay already?
text: もう完全に治ったみたいだよ — it's like it's already completely healed
text: もう完全に治ったみたいだよ — it's like it's already completely healed
text: もうバッチリ — totally fine now (Gon on his own recovery)

english: the expected time to fully recover (medical term, usu. 全治~ヶ月)
notes: text: 全治4か月のケガをたった1か月で完治させやがった!! — he went and made a full 4-month injury heal completely in just 1 month!!
text: 全治4か月のケガをたった1か月で完治させやがった!! — he made a full 4-month injury heal completely in just 1 month!!

english: a priority ticket, a VIP pass
notes: text: 200階クラスの闘士ってことで優先券がとれたんだ — since I'm a 200th-floor-class fighter, I got a priority pass

english: just an ordinary ~, a mere ~ (often with じゃない: "no ordinary ~")
notes: text: ただのじゃないぜ — this ain't just some ordinary (ticket)

english: stingy, petty, cheap (of a person's behavior)
notes: text: でもせこいよなー金はしっかりとるんだぜ — but that's so cheap, huh — he sure makes sure to collect the money
text: ヒソカ戦大人気だぜ — the Hisoka match is super popular
text: すげー行列ができてて — there was a huge line
text: ダフ屋まで出てたくらいだ — there were even scalpers out

english: a loss by forfeit/default (without actually fighting)
notes: text: 3敗は全部不戦敗 — all 3 losses were forfeits
text: 実際に戦えば負けなしってことだ — meaning if he actually fights, he's never lost
text: 実力はもう間違いなくマスタークラスだってよ — his skill is already undoubtedly master-class, they say
text: うわーまいったなー — whoa, you got me there
text: 唯一ヒソカからダウンを奪ってる男だ — the only man who's ever taken a knockdown from Hisoka

english: to take away, to seize, to snatch
notes: text: 唯一ヒソカからダウンを奪ってる男だ — the only man who's ever taken a knockdown from Hisoka

english: a fated connection, a grudge/history between two parties
notes: text: 因縁の対決ってやつだな — it's what you'd call a fated showdown

english: to mutually arrange, to agree upon together
notes: text: お互い申しあわせて戦闘日を指定したらしい — seems they mutually agreed and set the date of the fight
text: 多少はヒソカの戦い方が分析できるぜ — I can analyze Hisoka's fighting style at least a little
text: 本気のヒソカが見れるかもよ — we might get to see a serious Hisoka

english: to be equivalent to, to amount to
notes: text: 試合観戦も念を調べる行為に相当します — even watching the match counts as an act of investigating Nen

english: to concentrate solely on, to devote oneself to
notes: text: 君はあと1か月治療のみに専念しなさい — you should focus solely on treatment for one more month

english: an order, an instruction (from a person in authority)
notes: text: 言いつけをちゃんと守り — properly keeping to (his) instructions

kana: つうじょうじょうたい
notes: text: 通常状態で微弱に流れ出るオーラのイメージが — the image of aura faintly leaking out even in a normal state

english: vividly, exactly as it is, realistically
notes: text: それを如実に物語っている — it speaks to that vividly
text: 彼らのそれは静寂の大河を彷彿とさせる — theirs is reminiscent of a great, silent river

english: to be reminiscent of, to evoke
notes: text: 彼らのそれは静寂の大河を彷彿とさせる — theirs is reminiscent of a great, silent river

english: to disturb one's composure/peace of mind
notes: text: 私の方が心を乱されているのではないか — isn't it that I'm the one whose composure is being disturbed?

english: a multimillionaire, an extremely wealthy person
notes: text: 億万長者のくせに — and here you are a multimillionaire (sarcastic, i.e. he could easily afford it)
text: 試合は録画もしとくとして — I'll have the match recorded as well
text: とにかくオレだけ行って観てくるぜ — anyway, I'm just gonna go watch it myself

english: to watch, to view (a performance, match, etc.)
notes: text: とにかくオレだけ行って観てくるぜ — anyway, I'm just gonna go watch it myself

english: a huge crowd, a massive audience
notes: text: ごらん下さいこの大観衆!! — take a look at this huge crowd!!
text: まだ決戦の1時間前だというのに — even though it's still an hour before the showdown
text: 会場はすでに超満員です!! — the venue is already packed beyond capacity!!

english: a win-loss record, a track record (in competition)
notes: text: 戦績は8勝3敗ですが — his record is 8 wins, 3 losses, but

english: prone to being absent, often inactive/off
notes: text: 休みがちの死神奇術師ヒソカ — the often-absent death-god trickster, Hisoka

english: a conjurer, an illusionist, a trickster
notes: text: 休みがちの死神奇術師ヒソカ — the often-absent death-god trickster, Hisoka

english: on the verge of victory, a decisive move (lit. "check" in shogi)
notes: text: 以来9連勝で王手!! — 9 wins in a row since then, closing in for the win!!

english: a public declaration, an open statement
notes: text: 借りは必ず返すの公言通りリベンジなるか!? — will he get his revenge as publicly declared: "I always repay what I owe"!?

english: a different person entirely, someone unrecognizably changed
notes: text: 2年前とは別人だってところをお見せします — I'll show you I'm a different person from two years ago
text: 勝算がないなら戦いませんよ — if there's no chance of winning, I won't fight

english: to make sure, to confirm, to verify
notes: text: たしかめてやるぜ — I'll go make sure of it
text: こいつは確かにあのイスに座っていた!! — this guy was definitely sitting in that chair!!

english: before one knows it, without one noticing
notes: text: いつのまに… — before I knew it… (he had vanished)
text: オレに気づかれずすばやくドアを開けて — quickly opening the door without me noticing

english: to slip through, to slip past
notes: text: オレの横をすりぬけ背後に!? — slipped past my side to get behind me!?
text: 今日は敵状視察かい? — are you here to scout the enemy today?
text: ぜーんぶバレバレなのね — you've been completely found out
text: 私の印象はどうだい — what's your impression of me?

english: to be on guard, to be wary/cautious
notes: text: 私でなくても警戒するよ — even if it weren't me, you'd be on your guard
text: 相当やるね — you're quite something, pretty capable
text: 残念ながら教えられないな — unfortunately, I can't tell you
text: いずれ君と戦うかもしれないしね — I might end up fighting you eventually, after all

english: to feel relieved, to be at ease
notes: text: 安心しなよ — relax, don't worry
text: ははは冗談だよ — haha, just kidding
text: 色紙もってくんの忘れたし — I forgot to bring the autograph board

english: finally, at last (the moment has come)
notes: text: さぁいよいよです!! — well, the moment has finally come!!
text: ヒソカ選手VSカストロ選手の大決戦!! — the great showdown between Hisoka and Castro!!
text: 感謝するよヒソカ — I'm grateful to you, Hisoka

english: a baptism; (fig.) a harsh initiation, a trial by fire
notes: text: お前の洗礼がなければ私はここまで強くなれなかっただろう — without your baptism, I probably wouldn't have gotten this strong
text: 全てお前を倒すための準備運動にすぎない! — all of it is nothing more than a warm-up for taking you down!
text: 一度として全力で戦ったことはない — I have never once fought at full strength

english: a preemptive strike, the first blow
notes: text: カストロ選手の先制打が炸裂ーっ!! — Castro's preemptive strike explodes!!
text: カストロ選手の先制打が炸裂ーっ!! — Castro's preemptive strike explodes!!

english: to dodge, to avoid (a physical blow)
notes: text: よけたはずの右手が…? — the right hand that should have dodged...?
text: 本気で来いヒソカ — come at me seriously, Hisoka
